items.title: Police did not pass on key information to prison before suicide, inquest hears
items.summary: The inquest into a detainee who died by suicide hears police did not pass on critical information to prison staff which would have likely placed him on an at-risk mental health system.

items.title: Patients speak out about horrors of ICU delirium
items.summary: Doctors are playing with ICU delirium as they try and end the days of patients struggling with hallucinations and mental health issues during their recovery.

items.title: Gas reservation scheme set to pass parliament in bid to rein in energy costs
items.summary: Labor's plan to deliberately oversupply the domestic gas market is set to pass parliament, with the Coalition saying it will not oppose the bill.

items.title: Gosling case link denied, as NT Administrator racks up travel bill
items.summary: The NT chief minister claims "no involvement whatsoever" in the case against Labor MP Luke Gosling, as the NT Administrator racks up a $10k a day bill in the UK.

items.title: Returning Matildas star Cooney-Cross wants to make late mum 'proud'
items.summary: Kyra Cooney-Cross is preparing for her first Matildas' appearances since her mother's death in July, and she's ready to be back in the spotlight.

items.title: Curtains have closed on parliament for the year. Who walks away a winner?
items.summary: The government cleared almost everything it wanted off the legislative decks this week, but there were still plenty of surprises and shocks in store.

items.title: Scale of voyeur doctor's offending 'beggars belief', Melbourne court told
items.summary: Disgraced trainee surgeon Ryan Cho, who secretly filmed hundreds of colleagues in hospital toilets, could receive a reduced jail term because prosecutors combined his charges to streamline the case.

items.title: Dramatic audio released of teen's arrest after electric motorbike death
items.summary: A teenager accused of killing a Perth nurse after hitting her with an electric motorbike he was riding is heard telling police he only increased his speed because he was being chased by police.

items.title: Boy who died sleeping in bin subject of 29 child abuse reports, court hears
items.summary: A coronial inquest hears that dozens of abuse notifications were made involving the 13-year-old in the years leading up to his death after sleeping rough in a skip bin.

items.title: Lamarre-Condon staying in secretive prison unit as police review resumes
items.summary: Beau Lamarre-Condon's murder trial may be over but he now faces a long prison sentence and renewed scrutiny of his actions as a NSW Police officer.

items.title: Western Sydney jobless rate at highest level since pandemic
items.summary: Unemployment in the Merrylands-Guildford pocket of Sydney has surged to 7.8 per cent as almost 80,000 national jobs vanish, fuelling expectations of an August rate cut.

items.title: NSW Police found nothing to see here on killer constable
items.summary: NSW Police recruitment practices have come under renewed scrutiny following the murder convictions of a former senior constable.

items.title: Dumped Liberal candidate allowed to keep campaigning in party blue after court showdown
items.summary: Labor MP Melissa Horne’s lawyer said the disendorsed Liberal had made an “imperfect and contravening attempt to remove his association with the Liberal Party”, which risked misleading voters.

items.title: More charges after alleged Schoolies bashing
items.summary: Police have laid more charges after an alleged bashing on the Gold Coast that left a teenage boy fighting for life.

items.title: Minister was ‘everywhere’ inside building watchdog, inquiry told
items.summary: A former watchdog executive testified Mick de Brenni was ‘everywhere’ in key decisions, while a Townsville builder revealed police warned him of a possible hit.

items.title: ‘Incredibly distressing’: Teen beaten on Gold Coast still critical, community rallies support
items.summary: A court has heard a 15-year-old boy beaten allegedly into unconsciousness on the Gold Coast has shown no activity in recent brain scans and remained intubated.

items.title: Career of killer cop under scrutiny
items.summary: After being found guilty of double murder, Beau Lamarre-Condon’s career as a police officer is under scrutiny.

items.title: Live Nation tightens grip on SEQ music scene with new Gold Coast hall
items.summary: Global giant Live Nation will run a new 2500-capacity music hall in Surfers Paradise, adding to a growing south-east Queensland stable that includes the Fortitude.

items.title: Matilda Bay ferry terminal to be built despite petition, cost blow outs
items.summary: Treasurer Rita Saffioti conceded costs had jumped by about $40 million.

items.title: Flight Centre hit by cyber incident affecting ‘significant number’ of customers
items.summary: The incident appears to affect the accommodation system used by Flight Centre and travel brands Travel Associates, Cruiseabout, and some independent agents.
